claims.claim: USDA minimum internal temperature is 145°F plus three-minute rest for whole pork/beef cuts, 160°F for ground meat and 165°F for poultry.
claims.interpretation: Domain-specific implementation premise; jurisdiction and product variations acknowledged

claims.claim: Cooking duration is user-estimated, not a physical model; actual doneness requires calibrated probe temperature, resting and safe holding. Food should not be kept unsafely in temperature danger zones.
